name: Debra Glowaski
title: Psychologist
description: Debra is a senior psychologist specialising in trauma informed counselling, critical incident support and brief intervention work with individuals experiencing stress, conflict, psychological injury and complex workplace dynamics. Trauma-informed counselling & psychological first aid • Critical Incident Stress Debriefing (CISD) • Workplace conflict resolution, bullying & harassment support • Brief-intervention counselling & triage • Organisational reviews & interpersonal conflict diagnostics • Mediation, facilitated conversations & behavioural interventions • Leadership coaching & psychologically safe practice • Culture uplift, wellbeing strategy & DEI practice • Governance, risk & stakeholder stewardship • Workforce strategy, organisational design & capability uplift

name: Dr Kayleigh Young
title: Psychologist
description: She has worked across both the public and private sector with youth and adult clients experiencing a range of presenting issues including depression and anxiety, violent and sexual offending, sexual abuse, workplace bullying and harassment, trauma, substance use, family violence, suicide risk, and other mental health issues. Kayleigh has a particular interest in the impacts of trauma and is experienced in the delivery of a range of critical incident support services. Kayleigh’s experience with children and adolescents and their families includes psychological assessment and therapeutic intervention via private clinics as well as through the Gatehouse Centre at Royal Children’s Hospital, specialising in helping traumatised families who have experienced disruptions due to suspected and actual sexual abuse.

name: Elizabeth Power
title: Psychologist
description: Liz has supported clients with a range of presentations including anxiety, depression, trauma, grief, and stress. Liz also has interests in sexual health and organisational psychology. This includes sexual disorders and dysfunction; as well as sexual education.

name: Hoa Pham
title: Psychologist
description: She draws on cognitive behavioural therapy, acceptance commitment therapy and schema therapy techniques when working with clients.

name: Lauren McKeogh
title: Psychologist
description: Throughout her professional experience she has worked with a variety of clients with mental health and wellbeing concerns ranging from stress, anxiety, anger, bullying, sexual assault victim/survivors, workplace stress and bullying, to trauma and vicarious trauma.

name: Lauren Pearson
title: Psychologist
description: Her experience includes working supporting clients with relationship difficulties, experiences of trauma or abuse, sexual difficulties, life transitions, improving emotional awareness and management, developing insight into problem behaviours, and mental health concerns such as depression and anxiety.

name: Leo Louw
title: Counsellor
description: The Rand Afrikaans University in South Africa (now University of Johannesburg) sponsored the creation of a Trauma Counselling Centre (Crisis intervention for victims of violent crimes), and Leonete served on the steering committee with the university, chaired the volunteer committee and served as a trauma counsellor at the centre in the late 1990’s. Leonete’s experience includes phone (Careline) and crisis counselling, multi-cultural diversity training (including doing needs analyses & designing & facilitating training), extensive experience in multi-cultural situations (i.e., race, gender, LGBTIQ+, culture, religion, and other areas), organisational Change management (from needs analyses to designing & implementing interventions) and leadership development training.

name: Marcos Benhamu
title: Psychologist
description: He offers inclusive therapy that respects his clients’ background, including gender, race, social class, and sexual orientation.
